answer: What survives to the umber is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, each submission carries a fresh nonce. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Work waits on the garden until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the shale of the next round.
